_about: Jak II's prefabs: ready-made assemblies of Jak II's decor, made by the editor from the user's own extracted Jak II levels (no data of the game here: names of levels and decor parts only), brought into Jak 3 levels as its structures are (textures named jak2-<name>). Same fields as data/jak3/prefabs.json; see src/io/prefab_recipes.h.
